thesis: 截至09:04 SGT，周末市场的绑定约束仍是“能源物流受损能否在周一价格发现前被可验证地修复”：Saudi已确认East-West pipeline遭Iraq方向无人机袭击并选择暂不报复，但截至research cutoff未见官方恢复运行公告；Houthis推进至Perim提高Bab el-Mandeb风险，而Iranian official称Monday Oman meeting不预期立即签署Hormuz协议。Friday Brent $104.61与S&P 500 +0.86%的relief close因此尚未计入完整weekend information set；若周一油价与UST 2Y同步上行，能源冲击将再次转化为Fed/discount-rate压力。
dominant_narrative: Friday cash market priced a partial relief：crude回落、VIX降至15.84、美国股指反弹；但周末信息只是缩小了最坏情形，并没有消除实体约束。Saudi选择暂不报复降低了立即升级风险，BRICS也呼吁最大克制，但East-West pipeline截至cutoff没有已确认的恢复公告，Houthis在Perim附近的推进提高Bab el-Mandeb风险，同时Monday Oman meeting被Iranian official明确描述为不预期立即形成Hormuz签署协议。第一道可信裁决因此不是更多headline，而是Monday 06:00 SGT附近WTI/Brent、UST前端与美股期货是否出现同向重新定价；只有跨资产确认，才能把周末地缘事件升级为新的金融条件冲击。

top_catalysts.event: Saudi East-West pipeline has no confirmed restart after Iraq-launched drone attacks, leaving the main Hormuz bypass impaired
top_catalysts.what_happened: Saudi Arabia confirmed that multiple drones launched from Iraq struck the East-West Pipeline; the line was shut as a precaution and technical teams were assessing damage. Through the 09:04 SGT research cutoff, no official Saudi restoration notice was identified.
top_catalysts.what_changed: Compared with the Sep11 formal close, attribution is clearer, Saudi Arabia has chosen not to retaliate for now, but the key land bypass still lacks a confirmed restart.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: The East-West route has recently carried roughly 4–5 million bpd and is the principal Saudi bypass around Hormuz, so uncertain restoration keeps a physical supply constraint alive into the Sunday reopen.
top_catalysts.transmission: Pipeline outage / uncertain restart → reduced bypass flexibility → oil and tanker premium → inflation expectations → Fed path and global discount rates → equity valuation.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Official Saudi confirmation that repairs are incomplete, a firm crude gap higher, or further freight tightening would confirm that the constraint remains economically binding.
top_catalysts.invalidation: A verified Saudi restoration announcement plus stable shipping flows and a muted crude reopen would invalidate the immediate supply-gap thesis.

top_catalysts.event: Monday Oman talks are not expected to produce a signed Hormuz deal, limiting the near-term diplomatic relief case
top_catalysts.event_time_et: 2026-09-14 — meeting time 尚无法可靠确认
top_catalysts.event_time_sgt: 2026-09-14 — meeting time 尚无法可靠确认
top_catalysts.what_happened: An Iranian official told Reuters that Monday's Oman meeting between Iran and Gulf states is not expected to produce a signed agreement on the Strait of Hormuz, even as talks continue over regional security and possible governance arrangements.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The market entered Friday with intermittent hopes for de-escalation, but the weekend guidance lowers the probability that Monday immediately restores normal shipping conditions.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Without a near-term agreement, oil and tanker markets must keep pricing disrupted Hormuz flows while the alternative Saudi route is also impaired and Bab el-Mandeb risk has increased.
top_catalysts.transmission: No quick Hormuz accord → persistent tanker scarcity and rerouting → elevated delivered-energy costs → sticky inflation → tighter global policy expectations.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Monday talks ending without operational shipping concessions, or renewed vessel attacks before the meeting, would confirm the diplomatic ceiling.
top_catalysts.invalidation: A verifiable interim arrangement that materially restores commercial passage through Hormuz would reduce the oil and freight premium.

top_catalysts.event: Fed enters September meeting week with August CPI at +0.4% m/m and a 25bp hike heavily priced
top_catalysts.what_happened: August U.S. CPI rose 0.4% month on month and 3.4% year on year; Reuters reported the probability of a 25bp September hike rising to about 86%, while the official Fed calendar confirms a September 15–16 FOMC meeting.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The CPI release converted the next Fed meeting from an open inflation test into a meeting with a hike heavily priced, as the 2Y yield closed at 4.63% and the 10Y at 4.96%.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: With oil above $100 and the 10Y near 5%, another policy tightening step can reinforce the discount-rate shock even if weekend diplomacy prevents a fresh oil spike.
top_catalysts.transmission: Hotter monthly inflation + energy shock → higher hike odds → front-end yield pressure → stronger discount rate → valuation compression in long-duration growth and smaller companies.
top_catalysts.confirmation: A firm Monday 2Y yield, resilient dollar and unchanged high market-implied hike probability would confirm that policy tightening remains the second binding constraint.
top_catalysts.invalidation: A sharp oil reversal plus materially softer pre-FOMC data or official communication that reprices the meeting away from a hike would weaken this catalyst.

top_catalysts.title: Top 3 Market Catalysts
top_catalysts.summary: 周末的核心不是新增宏观数据，而是三条约束是否在周一价格发现时同向：Saudi East-West pipeline停运、Hormuz短期协议概率下降，以及Fed会议周的高利率约束。
paragraphs: Saudi East-West pipeline仍缺乏恢复运行的官方确认，而Saudi方面已确认无人机来自Iraq并选择暂不报复。这个组合降低了即时国家间升级概率，却没有解除实体供给瓶颈；市场必须区分“军事克制”和“供给恢复”两件事。
Monday Oman meeting提供外交路径，但Iranian official已明确表示不预期立即签署Hormuz协议。因此周五油价回落所包含的外交乐观需要接受周一重开检验；真正的确认变量是航运能力、pipeline capacity和freight，而不是声明数量。
与此同时Fed进入9月会议周，2Y 4.63%、10Y 4.96%让energy shock更容易通过通胀预期传导至估值。若周一油价与短端收益率同涨，风险资产压力将显著高于单一油价冲击。

earnings.title: Important Earnings
earnings.status: 无重大新增事件；weekend corporate follow-up

paragraphs: Oracle周五财报后的核心分歧仍是AI cloud backlog增长能否转化为现金流。周六Ellison取消50m-share出售计划，消除了一个潜在内部人供给信号，但并未改变Oracle本财年计划通过债务与股权筹资约$40B的资本需求。
因此earnings revision信号保持“selective resilience”：AI需求证据仍强，但投资者对funding mix、restructuring和free-cash-flow recovery的要求没有下降。

us_macro.title: U.S. Economic Data
us_macro.summary: August CPI已经把政策焦点从“数据是否支持加息”转向“Fed是否兑现已高度定价的25bp紧缩”；本周末没有新的美国一级宏观数据覆盖这一判断。
paragraphs: August CPI上升0.4% m/m，Reuters报道9月25bp hike概率升至约86%。这一结果本身不是失控通胀，但在Brent仍高于$100、tanker freight显著上升的背景下，能源二次传导让Fed更难把供给冲击完全视作暂时因素。
下一轮美国高频验证包括Sep15 Empire State Manufacturing以及FOMC Sep15–16会议。增长若明显走弱而油价继续走高，将形成政策最困难的stagflation-lite组合。

central_banks.title: Global Central Banks
central_banks.summary: Fed、ECB与BOJ共同构成新的global tightening cluster：ECB已加息25bp，Fed会议周加息高度定价，日本方向仍偏正常化，意味着油价冲击正面对比春季更紧的全球政策缓冲。
paragraphs: ECB在Sep10上调三大政策利率25bp，deposit facility将于Sep16升至2.50%，并预计通胀将在较长时间高于目标。这个动作确认欧洲也把能源冲击视作需要更强政策反应的风险。
Fed官方日程确认Sep15–16开会、Sep16 14:00 EDT公布决定；Reuters在CPI后给出约86%的25bp hike概率。即使周末油价不再上跳，市场仍需面对高基准利率与高term premium的双重约束。

geopolitics.title: Major International Events
geopolitics.summary: 中东风险的关键变化是从单一Hormuz问题扩展为Hormuz、Bab el-Mandeb与Saudi land bypass同时受约束；Saudi暂不报复降低一条尾部风险，但没有恢复能源物流能力。
paragraphs: Saudi Foreign Ministry确认袭击East-West pipeline的无人机从Iraq发射，并表示基于Iraqi PM请求暂不回应。这个信号有助于抑制立即的Saudi-Iraq升级，但Saudi仍保留采取必要措施的权利。
Houthis推进至Perim使Bab el-Mandeb成为第二个更现实的能源与航运 chokepoint。由于Saudi此前依赖Red Sea方向绕开Hormuz，Red Sea风险与East-West停运会互相放大，而不是简单替代。
BRICS New Delhi Declaration一致呼吁最大克制与外交解决，构成周末最明确的外交缓和信号；但它尚未转化为可验证的航运恢复或停火安排。

regional_policy.title: China, Japan, Europe and Canada Policy
regional_policy.summary: 区域政策正在围绕能源与通胀做分化应对：中国继续压低国内燃油价格传导，Europe以ECB加息直接应对，Canada即将公布CPI，而China-India在BRICS场边尝试改善贸易与供应链关系。
paragraphs: China自Sep12起把汽油和柴油零售价格分别上调260和250 yuan/ton，低于标准机制下应有的435和420 yuan/ton涨幅。这是明确的domestic inflation buffer，但也意味着政策部门吸收部分全球油价冲击。
Xi与Modi在New Delhi强调商业、交通、市场准入和供应链问题，2025 bilateral trade达到$155.6B。短期这不是足以改变全球风险资产的催化剂，但对Asia supply-chain risk premium和China-India industrial linkages是边际改善。
Canada将在Sep14公布August CPI；在USDCAD周五升至约1.386、Fed加息预期上升的背景下，加拿大通胀将影响BoC相对Fed的政策差。

index_changes.summary: 截至本次cutoff未发现需要进入主线的MSCI、FTSE、S&P或Nasdaq重大指数成分调整；本周末的市场风险主要来自宏观、能源与地缘，而不是被动指数流量。
paragraphs: 周一若出现显著指数期货gap，应优先解释为weekend geopolitical / rates repricing，而不是未经证实的index-rebalance flow。任何后续成分调整只有在index provider正式公告后才进入confirmed状态。

flows.title: Pension / Month-End / Quarter-End Flows
flows.summary: 当前并非month-end或quarter-end关键再平衡窗口，且没有可靠来源支持一个足以主导周一开盘的pension flow估计，因此不把未验证的机械流量写成市场驱动。
paragraphs: 如果周一发生大幅跨资产波动，首要归因顺序应是油价、rates、volatility与geopolitical headlines；只有在可靠dealer或institutional estimate出现后才把systematic flow作为二级放大器。

etf.title: ETF Rebalance / Index Reconstruction
etf.summary: 未发现QQQ、SPY、SMH、SOXX或主要AI ETF在周末出现足以改变基准风险判断的正式再平衡公告；ETF本身更可能成为周一价格传导载体而非独立催化剂。
paragraphs: 重点观察SMH/SOXX与QQQ在周一现金开盘后的相对强弱：若SOX期货/半导体继续明显强于Nasdaq，即说明AI硬件盈利韧性仍能部分抵消rates shock；若同步转弱，则discount-rate约束占优。

options.status: No major expiry inside immediate weekend window
options.summary: 当前最重要的options变量不是未经验证的gamma flip或max pain，而是周日/周一gap后隐含波动率是否重新抬升；任何dealer positioning数字在没有可靠来源时都不做猜测。
paragraphs: VIX周五收于15.84并明显回落，但这一close早于完整weekend news set。若周一VIX futures与equity futures同时向risk-off方向移动，说明Friday vol compression被重新定价；反之则表明headline premium有限。

treasury.title: U.S. Treasury Auctions
treasury.status: Rates focus shifts to FOMC / no major coupon result in this window
treasury.summary: 当前72小时主导rates的不是新完成coupon auction，而是CPI后的Fed路径与油价风险；官方Treasury curve显示2Y 4.63%、10Y 4.96%、30Y 5.35%。
paragraphs: 2s10s降至约+33bp，显示front end对Fed更敏感。若周一能源价格上跳同时2Y上行，属于inflation-policy传导；若10Y单独突破5%而2Y稳定，则term premium / fiscal supply的重要性更高。
未来auction结果在官方发布前必须保持待公布；本期不填入未经确认的WI、tail或bid-to-cover。

commodities.title: Oil / OPEC / Commodities
commodities.summary: Oil remains the dominant commodity transmission channel:Brent $104.61 and WTI $100.05 are Friday settlements that precede the latest pipeline and Hormuz-talk information; copper is elevated but volatile, while gold remains caught between haven demand and high yields.
paragraphs: East-West pipeline downtime matters because it removes or constrains a land route that had become more valuable asHormuz traffic deteriorated. Meanwhile tanker freight has surged, so delivered crude and product costs can remain high even if benchmark futures do not immediately retest the week's highs.

IEA's assessment of sharply lower 2026 supply and depleted inventories raises the sensitivity of prices to another infrastructure event. This is why theSunday futures open is more informative than extrapolating Friday's -2.8% Brent move.

Copper closed around$6.557/lb after a sharp tariff-driven reversal from record highs. Its mixed signal suggests industrial-demand optimism has not disappeared, but policy/tariff positioning can dominate short-term price action.

financing.title: IPO / Financing / Capital Cycle
financing.summary: Oracle周末撤回Ellison 50m-share出售计划，减轻单一股东供给压力，但公司本财年约$40B debt/equity funding计划仍把AI基础设施扩张与资本成本紧密绑定；OpenAI同时表示2026不IPO。
paragraphs: Oracle的信号不是“AI capex问题消失”，而是equity-overhang composition发生变化：insider sale被取消，但cloud capacity仍需要大规模外部资本。高利率环境下，AI需求强度必须用future cash generation来证明融资回报。
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman表示2026不会IPO，并把AI safety作为原因之一。该信息降低了一个潜在超大型equity issuance近期出现的概率，但也强化frontier-AI governance可能影响资本市场时间表的认识。

breaking_news.title: Past 24H Major Breaking News
breaking_news.summary: 过去24小时最具市场含义的新增集中在Saudi response、Hormuz diplomacy、Red Sea control risk、BRICS diplomatic messaging与AI capital-markets decisions，而非新的美国现金市场价格。
paragraphs: Saudi Arabia确认East-West pipeline袭击无人机来自Iraq，并选择暂不报复；这一决定降低即时state-to-state escalation，但pipeline damage仍在处理。
Reuters报道Monday Oman Hormuz meeting不预期立即签署协议；同时Houthis在Perim的存在提高对Bab el-Mandeb的控制威胁。这两条消息共同削弱“周一快速恢复正常航运”的bull case。
BRICS一致通过New Delhi Declaration，呼吁Middle East最大克制与外交解决，是过去24小时最明确的官方多边de-escalation signal。
Oracle Ellison取消50m-share出售计划，OpenAI表示2026不IPO；两者都影响AI capital-cycle的equity-supply预期，但性质不同：Oracle是已披露出售计划撤回，OpenAI是IPO时间表延后。

market_impact.title: Integrated Market Impact
market_impact.status: Cross-asset confirmation required at Sunday/Monday reopen
market_impact.summary: 当前结论不能仅凭weekend headline给方向，必须等listed markets重开做交叉验证：oil、front-end rates、equity futures与volatility四条链若同向，才说明供给冲击升级为系统性金融条件收紧。
paragraphs: Base case下，油价保留weekend premium但不出现失序跳涨，rates维持高位、equity futures先弱后稳。Bull case需要Saudi恢复pipeline或Hormuz出现可验证operational concession；Bear case则是新的physical attack或双chokepoint进一步收紧。
对AI/semis而言，SOX周五+1.97%提供相对强势基础，但10Y接近5%与Oracle融资讨论会持续测试duration和capex-heavy估值。对FX而言，JPY已经显著走强，carry stability是判断global deleveraging是否启动的重要辅助信号。

growth_impulse.label: Growth
growth_impulse.change_reason: Friday U.S. equities rebounded, but the weekend energy shock can still act as a tax on consumption and industrial margins.
growth_impulse.evidence: S&P 500 +0.86% Friday while Brent remains above $100 and Canada/Empire data arrive before the FOMC.

inflation_impulse.label: Inflation
inflation_impulse.change_reason: Physical oil-routing constraints and record tanker costs remain unresolved after an August CPI monthly acceleration.
inflation_impulse.evidence: Brent settled $104.61; August CPI +0.4% m/m; East-West pipeline remains without a confirmed restart and VLCC freight is elevated.

rates_pressure.label: Rates
rates_pressure.change_reason: The Fed enters meeting week with a hike heavily priced while the 10Y sits just below 5% and the ECB has already tightened.
rates_pressure.evidence: UST 2Y 4.63%, 10Y 4.96%; Reuters put September 25bp Fed-hike odds near 86%; ECB raised rates 25bp on Sep10.

earnings_revision.label: Earnings
earnings_revision.change_reason: Oracle removed a potential 50m-share insider-sale overhang, but its large debt/equity funding plan keeps cash conversion central to the AI trade.
earnings_revision.evidence: Oracle said no shares were sold under Ellison's canceled plan; the company still plans $40B of current-fiscal-year financing.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.change_reason: VIX and equities relaxed Friday, but weekend news has not yet passed through listed U.S. futures or cash markets.
liquidity.evidence: VIX closed 15.84 and S&P 500 rose 0.86%; WTI reopens Sunday 18:00 EDT, making that session the first broad weekend repricing point.

geopolitical_risk.label: Geopolitical Risk
geopolitical_risk.change_reason: Saudi restraint lowers immediate retaliation risk, but pipeline downtime, Houthi control risk and the absence of a quick Hormuz deal keep the physical-risk set wide.
geopolitical_risk.evidence: Saudi Arabia held off retaliation; Houthis reached Perim; an Iranian official said Monday Oman talks are not expected to yield a signed Hormuz agreement.

base_case.label: Base Case
base_case.trigger: No new major strike before Sunday open; Saudi pipeline remains offline or restart timing stays uncertain; Oman talks proceed without an immediate signed Hormuz deal.
base_case.expected_market_reaction: Oil opens with a positive risk premium but below panic conditions; UST 2Y/10Y remain firm, equity futures soften initially and then stabilize if no fresh physical disruption appears.
base_case.what_confirms_it: Oil holds above Friday settlement without a disorderly spike, rates remain elevated, and equity futures absorb the weekend headlines without cascading de-risking.
base_case.what_invalidates_it: Either an official Saudi restoration plus credible Hormuz concession creates broad relief, or a new attack creates a much larger oil/futures gap.

bull_case.label: Bull Case
bull_case.trigger: Saudi Arabia announces verified pipeline restoration before/around the market open and Oman diplomacy yields an operational shipping concession even without a full treaty.
bull_case.expected_market_reaction: Brent/WTI surrender part of the geopolitical premium, Treasury yields ease on lower inflation risk, VIX/futures stay calm and rate-sensitive equities extend Friday's rebound.
bull_case.what_confirms_it: Official capacity restoration, measurable improvement in shipping flow or freight rates, and simultaneous declines in crude and long yields.
bull_case.what_invalidates_it: Any renewed infrastructure/shipping attack or explicit rejection of operational concessions by parties to the Oman process.

bear_case.label: Bear Case
bear_case.trigger: A new strike hits Saudi/Red Sea infrastructure, Houthis impede Bab el-Mandeb traffic, or the Saudi pipeline remains shut with no workaround as Hormuz diplomacy stalls.
bear_case.expected_market_reaction: Oil gaps sharply higher; UST curve initially bear-flattens as inflation expectations rise; equity futures and small caps sell off, volatility jumps and the dollar/yen reaction becomes disorderly.
bear_case.what_confirms_it: Crude and freight surge together while equity futures fall and 2Y yields rise, producing clear cross-asset confirmation of an inflationary supply shock.
bear_case.what_invalidates_it: Rapid de-escalation, verified route restoration or a muted oil open that fails to transmit into rates and equity volatility.

top_risks.risk: Weekend energy gap: the Saudi Hormuz bypass has no confirmed restart while Bab el-Mandeb risk remains elevated
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: Friday cash closes preceded the latest Saudi attribution/restraint details and the weekend confirmation that Monday Oman talks are not expected to deliver a signed Hormuz accord.
top_risks.trigger: No verified East-West restoration before the listed-market reopen, or a fresh shipping/infrastructure incident.
top_risks.transmission: Less bypass flexibility plus higher shipping risk → crude/freight gap → inflation expectations → front-end yields and weaker equity futures.

top_risks.risk: Near-5% U.S. 10Y and a heavily priced Fed hike turn the energy shock into a valuation shock
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: Friday equities rebounded even as official Treasury yields remained restrictive and the next Fed meeting moved closer with oil still above $100.
top_risks.trigger: UST 10Y sustains above 5% or the 2Y rises further as oil and inflation expectations reprice at the Sunday/Monday open.
top_risks.transmission: Higher real/nominal discount rates → lower long-duration equity multiples → tighter credit/funding → weaker AI and small-cap risk appetite.

top_risks.risk: Friday's risk-on close may reverse when futures price the weekend's physical-supply and diplomatic information
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: S&P 500, Nasdaq and VIX closed before the weekend produced a Saudi no-retaliation statement, no pipeline restart, a stronger Houthi chokepoint position and guidance that Monday's Oman talks are unlikely to sign a Hormuz deal.
top_risks.trigger: S&P/Nasdaq futures open materially lower while WTI/Brent gap higher and VIX futures rise, creating cross-asset confirmation rather than a single-market headline move.
top_risks.transmission: Weekend information gap → equity-index gap lower → volatility and hedging demand higher → systematic de-risking at Monday cash open.

next_catalyst.event: CME WTI and major U.S. futures reopen after the Saudi pipeline / Hormuz weekend
next_catalyst.consensus: No official consensus; the key question is whether weekend physical-supply news produces a material upside crude gap
next_catalyst.previous: WTI $100.05/bbl and Brent $104.61/bbl at Sep11 settlement; S&P 500 7,656.98 at Sep11 cash close
next_catalyst.why_it_matters: This is the first broad listed-market window to price Saudi pipeline downtime, Houthi control risk and the reduced probability of a quick Hormuz agreement, before Monday cash markets reopen.
next_catalyst.bull_interpretation: Crude opens flat-to-lower and equity futures remain firm if traders believe Saudi repairs and diplomacy can contain the physical supply loss.
next_catalyst.bear_interpretation: A large crude gap higher with 2Y/10Y yields and VIX futures rising would confirm that weekend events have converted Friday's relief rally into a renewed inflation-risk shock.
